_manifest.policy: Every source carries a `tos` field (open | permitted | restricted | prohibited). Only open/permitted sources ship in v1. Anything restricted/prohibited is excluded pending explicit owner approval. All upstream fetches route through the edge-cache Function with a descriptive User-Agent and generous TTLs; the client uses edge -> direct -> last-good triple fallback with stamped staleness.
_manifest.verification_environment_note: Live verification ran 2026-07-12. This build environment's egress proxy 403-blocks api.sleeper.app, fantasyfootballcalculator.com, and api.open-meteo.com (confirmed at the CONNECT tunnel), so those shapes were confirmed from official docs but NOT live-captured here. They are marked status:"unverified" and MUST be re-confirmed with a live call from the deploy environment before public launch. raw.githubusercontent.com IS reachable, so nflverse is status:"verified" (live-fetched).
hard_prohibitions: No scraping/reproduction of FantasyPros ECR or any paywalled expert rankings/projections.
No platform logos or marks — nominative text references only ("ESPN ADP" as a label is fine).
No reproduction of editorial content from any source.
